gloss: to be equipped with, to possess

definitions.gloss: to be equipped with, to possess
definitions.explanation: To have something as a built-in feature or quality.

examples.japanese: {才能|さいのう}を具えている。

notes:
{具|そな}える means to possess or be equipped with inherent qualities or features.

KANJI DISTINCTION:
Three verbs read そなえる with different nuances:
- {具|そな}える: to possess (innate qualities)
- {備|そな}える: to prepare, equip (external)
- {供|そな}える: to offer (to gods/deceased)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {才能|さいのう}を{具|そな}える: to possess talent
- {条件|じょうけん}を{具|そな}える: to meet the requirements
- {要素|ようそ}を{具|そな}える: to have the elements

GRAMMAR NOTE:
Often used in the pattern 〜を{具|そな}えた + noun:
- {才能|さいのう}を{具|そな}えた{人|ひと}: a talented person
- {機能|きのう}を{具|そな}えた{製品|せいひん}: a product equipped with features

This form is relatively formal/literary.
